questions.question: When does Nanami arrive relative to the fight?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Kento Nanami vs. Mahito

answer.item: Nanami arrives in the nick of time to save Yuji from what could've been a fatal blow from Mahito

questions.question: What bad news does Yuji give Nanami?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Kento Nanami vs. Mahito

answer.item: Yuji reveals that he was unable to save Junpei or his mother from the curses

questions.question: What does Nanami confirm about Yuji and Mahito?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Kento Nanami vs. Mahito

answer.item: Nanami confirms that Yuji is able to harm Mahito and surmises Mahito must have a reason he can't kill Yuji

questions.question: What strategy does Nanami develop?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Kento Nanami vs. Mahito

answer.item: Nanami develops a strategy to use his cursed technique to stifle Mahito's movements while relentlessly attacking with Yuji, who can eventually land a killing blow

questions.question: How does Mahito prepare for the fight?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Kento Nanami vs. Mahito

answer.item: Mahito prepares himself by creating an eyeball on his left palm while shifting is entire left arm into a bladed shape

questions.question: How does Mahito counter the sorcerers' first combined assault?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Kento Nanami vs. Mahito

answer.item: Mahito transforms his entire body into a sphere of extending spikes

questions.question: How does Mahito evade the sorcerers' next attack?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Kento Nanami vs. Mahito

answer.item: Mahito is able to evade by transforming his body into a child-like version of himself and slips between his opponents

questions.question: What does Mahito regurgitate to fight Yuji?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Kento Nanami vs. Mahito

answer.item: Mahito changes back to normal and regurgitates several small transfigured humans

questions.question: How do Yuji and Nanami land a combined hit?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Kento Nanami vs. Mahito

answer.item: Yuji cracks him hard with a strong right hook, and Nanami follows up by creating a weak point in Mahito's face and smashing it with his blunt sword

questions.question: What Domain Expansion does Mahito conjure?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Kento Nanami vs. Mahito

answer.item: Mahito conjures his very own Domain Expansion: Self-Embodiment of Perfection

questions.question: Who gets trapped inside Mahito's domain?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Kento Nanami vs. Mahito

answer.item: It immediately locks Yuji out and traps Nanami alone inside a void filled with Mahito's soul molding hands

questions.question: How does Sukuna damage Mahito when Yuji breaks into the domain?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Kento Nanami vs. Mahito

answer.item: Yuji breaks into the Domain Expansion from the outside. This forces Mahito to touch Yuji's soul, once again angering Sukuna. The King of Curses reminds Mahito that there wouldn't be a second warning, and slashes his body with two devastatingly deep cuts

questions.question: How does Mahito escape at the end?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Kento Nanami vs. Mahito

answer.item: this body pops like a balloon and Mahito's real body escapes back into the sewers

questions.question: Who does Nanami call to intercept Mahito?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Kento Nanami vs. Mahito

answer.item: Nanami immediately calls grade 2 sorcerer, Takuma Ino, to intercept Mahito in the sewers

questions.question: What does Mahito believe reviving Sukuna will bring?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Kento Nanami vs. Mahito

answer.item: He's confident that reviving Sukuna will bring about the age of curses

questions.question: What does Nanami tell Yuji about dying to prevent deaths?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Kento Nanami vs. Mahito

answer.item: Nanami points out that all people die differently and asks Yuji not to die trying to prevent unnatural deaths
